title: Russia Attacks Ukraine
summary: What has been the impact on the tanker market so far? A little more than a month ago, we wrote a Tanker Opinion discussion the possible implications of a potential conflict between Russia and the Ukraine. This potential conflict has turned into an actual war and the implications are felt throughout the shipping markets.
